html.htmlText: 🌴 Plan Your Relaxing Holiday at Amor De Goa by Mirashya Homes! ✨ Stay in this cozy 1BHK in the heart of Candolim, featuring a private jacuzzi 🛁 for the perfect unwind. Enjoy high-speed WiFi 💻, Smart TV 📺, pet-friendly comfort 🐾, and stylish interiors. Just minutes from Candolim Beach 🏖️, popular cafés, restaurants, and nightlife 🍹, it’s ideal for couples seeking romance, relaxation, and a touch of luxury in North Goa. ❤️🌴

Escape to Amor de Goa by Mirashya Homes, a serene 1BHK retreat in the heart of Candolim—perfect for couples, families, solo travelers, and work-from-anywhere stays. Thoughtfully designed with modern comforts and a touch of Goan charm, this space blends relaxation with convenience.

🛁 Highlights You’ll Love
• Private Jacuzzi for a relaxing unwind
• Cozy, stylish living space with modern interiors
• Private balcony for peaceful mornings & evenings
• Access to a tranquil shared swimming pool

🛏️ Comfort & Living
• Plush bedroom for restful sleep
• Bright, well-designed living area
• Clean bathroom with essential toiletries

🍳 Fully Equipped Kitchen
Cook with ease—includes cookware, utensils & appliances for short or long stays

📍 Prime Location – Candolim
• 10 mins to Candolim Beach
• Easy access to Baga, Calangute, Sinquerim & Fort Aguada
• Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, bars & supermarkets
• ~35–40 mins from MOPA Airport

✨ Amenities for a Perfect Stay
• High-speed Wi-Fi + dedicated workspace (WFH ready)
• Smart TV with streaming apps
• Housekeeping support
• Free parking
• Secure gated community with caretaker
• Pet-friendly 🐾

🌴 Ideal For
• Romantic getaways
• Family vacations
• Workations
• Peaceful staycations

🌟 Experience Goa, the Right Way
Whether you're here to explore or simply unwind, Amor de Goa offers the perfect mix of comfort, location, and tranquility.

📅 Book your Goa escape now—dates fill fast!

Warm regards,
Team Mirashya Homes
Guests have access to all the amenities of the apartment including the room and the common  areas like gym, parking area and swimming pool.

Our property is Vastu compliant and has been professionally verified by a certified Vastu consultant.

- Guest capacity should be respected. Unaccounted guests are not allowed.

- Pool timings are 9 am to 7pm. No eating/drinking/smoking near the pool area.

- The apartment has an inverter backup in case of any occasional power outages that occur in Goa.

- Being located in a gated community, we don't allow loud music in the property.

- Early check-ins/Late checkouts are subject to availability and will be charged additionally. Late checkout is permitted only with prior approval.

- Linen (bed linen & towels) will be changed every 3 days. Requests for the linen and towels to be changed daily they will be chargeable.

- We provide soap, shower gel and shampoo in all properties, other amenities like dental kits, shaving kits etc are all on request.

-Check-in and Luggage assistance to be provided.

- Housekeeping Staff will be available between 9 am to 6 pm.

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
🚗 Getting Around – Candolim, Goa
Getting around Candolim is easy and convenient, with multiple transport options available right outside the property.


📍 Highlights:
* Quick access to Candolim Beach (5–10 mins)
* Local taxis & bike rentals easily available nearby
* App-based cabs like GoaMiles operate in the area
* Well-connected roads to Calangute, Baga & Fort Aguada
* Scooter/bike rentals recommended for flexible travel
* Parking available for guests with private vehicles


Whether you prefer riding along the coast or hopping into a cab, exploring North Goa from here is smooth and hassle-free.

rules.title: House rules
rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
>Extra Person Charges
Please note that the standard occupancy for a 1BHK is 2 guests. The maximum number of guests allowed is 3. If the occupancy increases to 3 guests, an extra charge of ₹1,000 per night will be applicable.
>We have workspaces with desk and chair available. Please request them before you arrive, as it is subject to availability.
>Unregistered guests are not allowed in the apartment.
>Lost keys will be charged to the guests.
>Guests will be responsible for the cost of repairs for any damages caused to the property.
>No loud music after 10:00 PM.
> Pets are allowed at 500 rs per pet per night. Incase the pet fee has already been charged, the balance amount can be adjusted at checkout
>Don't take the property's belongings outside the premises.
>No illegal substances allowed.
>Please don't rearrange the furniture.
>Take care of the furnishings. Make sure there are no marks left. To avoid the same we suggest guests don't eat and drink in the rooms and always use coasters.
>Please switch off the electricity when not in use. Save Electricity!
>Please don't smoke indoors & always use an ashtray. Do not throw the buds anywhere in or around the premises.
>Use a trash can to dispose waste. Do not litter in and around the premises.
>For booking over 28 days, we charge extra for electricity : 7 rupee per unit as per consumption
>Housekeeping and dishwashing will be done everyday.  Linens to be changed once in 3 days. 
> Quiet hours : 10pm- 9am as per govt norms
>We have workspaces with desk and chair available. Please request them before you arrive, as it is subject to availability.
>Kindly note that a security deposit of INR 5000 will be collected upon check-in. This is a standard procedure to ensure the safety and upkeep of the property during your stay.
